LESSON: MAPS AND MAP WORK

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments in Africa
Topic 4.3: Maps and map work

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Maps and map work. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Maps and map work
2. Practise Maps and map work at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Maps and map work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Maps and map work
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Maps and map work. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Maps and map work at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Maps and map work at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Maps and map work
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Maps and map work. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Maps and map work using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Maps and map work in the examples.
2. Explain Maps and map work to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Maps and map work.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Maps and map work using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Maps and map work important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Maps and map work
2. Practise Maps and map work at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Maps and map work

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
